root_cause: A NullPointerException was thrown in MainActivity.updateCounterDisplay() because the counterTextView reference was null at call time — the view was not properly retained after a layout configuration change, causing the field to be stale when the crash button's onClick handler fired.
suggested_fix: Move the TextView reference assignment into onViewCreated() or re-query it in updateCounterDisplay() using findViewById() each time, and add a null-guard (if counterTextView != null) before calling setText() to prevent the crash if the view hierarchy is unexpectedly recycled.
evidence: View reference null — not reassigned after lifecycle event
Crash triggered by user interaction (onClick at line 64)
Memory pressure at time of crash: 8876 MB / 12288 MB used
